title: AKG for UML behavioral models: ontology, code, and data
description: Replication package of the article 'Architectural Knowledge Graphs from UML Behavioural Models for Early Architectural Bottleneck and Smell Detection': AKG ontology (RDFS/Turtle), extraction, sampling, reference-label and detection code, AKG materialization and SPARQL query execution, Train-Ticket models, and result files.
